newsitem.title: INDIA: Hongkong Bank cuts Indian prime rate to 16.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank cuts Indian prime rate to 16.0 pct.

text.p: Hongkong Bank said on Tuesday it cut its Indian prime lending rate by one percentage point to 16.0 percent with effect from April 16.
The bank said in a statement the cut was in response to the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) credit policy announcement earlier on Tuesday.
"The reduction in the prime lending rate is a statement of our intention to significantly expand our asset book," said Sanjiv Bhasin, a bank official.
"The Bank welcomes the initiatives of the RBI in making lending norms and guidelines market-driven," he said.
Hongkong Bank is a principal member of the HSBC Group.
